info.title: Eternet Test Planner
info.description: Dotnet tool for planning affected test selections from repository changes.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Plan affected test selections for Microsoft Testing Platform-friendly execution.

commands.name: partition
commands.description: Partition a selection manifest for execution.

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Selection manifest path.

options.name: --output
options.description: Optional output JSON path.

options.name: --settings
options.description: Optional partition settings JSON path.

options.name: --history
options.description: Optional TRX or compact history JSON path.

options.name: --timing-baseline
options.description: Optional compact timing baseline JSON path used to weight partitions.

options.name: --coalesce-methods-to-class
options.description: Collapse selected method fragments into one class fragment per class. [default: False]

options.name: --max-method-fragments-per-class
options.description: Collapse methods to a class fragment when selected method count for that class exceeds this value.

options.name: --method-selection-class-coverage-threshold
options.description: Collapse methods to a class fragment when selected method coverage for that class reaches this 0..1 threshold.

options.name: --max-class-fragments-per-project
options.description: Collapse class fragments to a project fragment when selected class count for that project exceeds this value.

options.name: --class-selection-project-coverage-threshold
options.description: Collapse classes to a project fragment when selected class coverage for that project reaches this 0..1 threshold.

options.name: --test-module-output-root
options.description: Optional root directory where affected test projects are built. Partition fragments emit TestModulePath values under this root.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Build configuration used to resolve default test module paths. [default: Release]

options.name: --partition-count
options.description: Number of partitions to produce. [default: 1]
